ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the vertical axis is labeled “per capita income/yuan,” and the values increase upward; the horizontal axis is labeled “percentage of the population engaged in manufacturing in the total population,” and the values increase to the right. The arrow in the figure indicates that manufacturing has migrated from type A regions to type B regions in recent years. Then reason: type A regions are relatively developed, while type B regions are relatively underdeveloped. In China's regional industrial transfer, the transfer of manufacturing from relatively developed regions to underdeveloped regions is usually accompanied by the output of enterprise investment, equipment, technology, and management experience, etc.; therefore, in essence, it represents the migration of capital and technology to the receiving area.
